description: Standalone components, controls, fields and hooks for the WordPress Gutenberg editor, consumed per component via subpath exports.
rules: Import from the narrowest public subpath, e.g. `import { MediaControl } from '@isudev/gutenberg/controls/MediaControl'`. Category barrels such as `@isudev/gutenberg/controls` are supported; importing from `dist/` or `_internal/` is not.
Nothing is read from a global registry. Icons, option lists and configuration are passed in as props — there is no place to register icons globally.
Where a field reads its options (`optionsSource`) is independent of where it reads and writes its value (`valueBinding`). Do not assume one implies the other.
Prefer easy mode (`MetaSelectControl`, `TaxonomySelectControl`) over advanced mode (`SelectField`, `RadioField`); advanced mode is for cases easy mode cannot express.
`@wordpress/*` and React are peer dependencies and stay external — the consumer's build resolves them to the WordPress-provided globals. `@wordpress/scripts` handles this by default.
Blocks consuming this library should declare `"apiVersion": 3` in block.json; WordPress 7.1 iframes the post editor unconditionally and apiVersion 2 blocks stop working there.
`AGENTS.md` in the package root is the module catalog: it lists every public module, its narrowest import and the path to that module's full README.
